events_seen: CUT (Nov 05 (today)): Jake released Najee Harris (RB, FA).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 04 (yesterday)): Adam added Carson Wentz (QB, MIN) for $7 FAAB (dropped George Holani (RB, SEA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 04 (yesterday)): Adam added Audric Estime (RB, NO) (dropped Tyler Higbee (TE, LAR)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 03 (2 days ago)): Kevin added Gardner Minshew II (QB, ARI) for $98 FAAB (dropped Jaleel McLaughlin (RB, CLE)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Nov 02 (3 days ago)): Brent added Roschon Johnson (RB, CHI).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 31 (5 days ago)): Ryan added Michael Carter (RB, TEN) (dropped Julian Hill (TE, NE)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 30 (6 days ago)): Drew added Michael Trigg (TE, DAL).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 30 (6 days ago)): Drew added Deion Burks (WR, IND).

WEEK 8 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Charles, 163.9-160.4 (NAIL-BITER); Adam def. Ryan, 117.0-107.2; Brent def. Drew, 137.5-70.4 (BLOWOUT); Wingard def. Fronge, 139.5-109.5; Jake def. Shaq, 148.9-137.5; Kevin def. Mitchum, 101.5-84.5

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Jake released Najee Harris today and I want to know what that means for the EchoPoint backfield heading into a must-win bubble game against Brent tonight. The RB room was already the question mark. Now it is a louder one.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: DREW IS 0-16 AND KEVIN JUST ADDED MINSHEW FOR $98 FAAB AND NOW GETS DREW IN WEEK 9. THE MATCHUP GODS DID NOT GIVE KEVIN A GAME. THEY GAVE HIM A BYE WITH EXTRA STEPS.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, I am 8-4 with a 1-1 lock record and I have exactly zero interest in pretending this is a close race at the top. Bo is also 8-4 and his locks are 2-0, which I respect, but I am watching Terrence prepare his schedule-difficulty speech for the third week in a row and I am not going to be the one to stop him.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: 5-7 is the number and I am not going to pretend it is not the number. What I will say is that Adam covering against Ryan was a pick that required reading four levels of roster signal correctly, and everyone in this building faded it. I did not. The record does not reflect the work.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Terrence just said 'the record does not reflect the work.' Terrence. The record IS the work. Locks are 2-0 this season, sitting at 7-5 overall, and I will simply allow the numbers to continue making my argument on my behalf.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: I am getting mail about putting Ryan ninth. Here is my answer: 7-9, 1-5 over the last three weeks, worst receiving corps in the league by grade, and $116.80 on the exchange after a 5.9% slide. I did not put him ninth to be provocative. The data put him ninth and I transcribed it accurately.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Corbishley-Charles at 163.9-160.4 is the kind of game that deserves a full post-mortem segment, and I want that segment. 13-3 CROWN, A.J. Brown in an APEX uniform, and the board reckoning is now a live conversation. Someone put me on a panel and let me talk about this for twenty minutes.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: The Weekly Ledger has a full accounting of what CROWN at $158.82 means the morning after a loss to Corbishley — that is a +9.4% valuation on a team whose board is now actively asking whether the regular season dominance converts. The market priced the ceiling. The question is the floor.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Wingard over Fronge and I want it on record that a 139.5-109.5 result is not a close call — that is a statement. ForgeHammer flew to Havana for regulatory flexibility and is currently 7-9 with no 2027 picks and a week 9 date against Charles. The flexibility has not been visible in the standings.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Adam adding Carson Wentz yesterday and Audric Estime on the same waiver wire is an interesting two-move window for a team at 4-12. The Helix turnaround story was the market's favorite redemption arc coming into the season. HLX is at $71.63 and down 6.1%. The arc has stalled in a specific and painful way.
